d: The Lallantop Show will discuss the terrorist attack in Jammu and Kashmir. On Wednesday afternoon, terrorists attacked a CRPF checkpoint in Kulgam district. Unidentified attackers arriving on a motorcycle opened fire on the personnel deployed there and then fled from the spot. Three CRPF jawans were injured in this attack. We will speak with our reporter present in Kashmir, and discuss the changing face of Kashmir after Pahalgam.
